**1. ऑनलाइन अपॉइंटमेंट (अनुशंसित):**
*   **ORS (Online Registration System):** आप [https://ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) पर जाकर अपना पंजीकरण कर सकते हैं। वहां 'Uttar Pradesh' और फिर 'KGMU' चुनें, विभाग और तारीख का चयन करें, और ₹50 का शुल्क जमा करके अपॉइंटमेंट स्लिप डाउनलोड करें।
*   **Health Care App:** आप अपने मोबाइल पर सरकारी Health Care App का उपयोग करके भी इसी प्रक्रिया से अपॉइंटमेंट ले सकते हैं।

**2. SMS के माध्यम से:**
*   आप अपने मोबाइल से `APPOINTMENT <NAME>` लिखकर **8887019134** पर SMS भेज सकते हैं।

**3. वॉक-इन (अस्पताल आकर):**
*   आप सीधे अस्पताल के OPD काउंटर पर जाकर भी पंजीकरण करा सकते हैं। इसके लिए अपना **आधार कार्ड** और **सक्रिय मोबाइल नंबर** साथ लाएं। वहां OTP के जरिए पंजीकरण होगा, जिसके बाद आपको टोकन मिलेगा और ₹50 का शुल्क देकर आप OPD स्लिप प्राप्त कर सकेंगे।

**महत्वपूर्ण जानकारी:**
*   **OPD का समय:** सोमवार से शुक्रवार (सुबह 9:00 से दोपहर 1:00 बजे तक) और शनिवार (सुबह 9:00 से दोपहर 12:00 बजे तक)। रविवार को OPD बंद रहती है।
*   **पर्ची काउंटर:** दोपहर 1:00 बजे काउंटर बंद हो जाते हैं, इसलिए समय से पहुंचना अनिवार्य है।
*   **रेफरल:** यदि आप लखनऊ के बाहर से आ रहे हैं, तो संबंधित विभाग का वैध रेफरल पत्र साथ जरूर लाएं।
*   **सहायता:** अधिक जानकारी के लिए आप 0522-2258880 या 0522-3539333 पर संपर्क कर सकते हैं।

कृपया अपनी सुरक्षा के लिए चैट में अपना आधार नंबर या अन्य निजी जानकारी साझा न करें।

entries.question: How to book online appointment in lory kgmu

3.  **SMS:**
    *   Send an SMS with the text `APPOINTMENT <Patient Name>` to **8887019134**.
4.  **Walk-in:**
    *   Bring your Aadhaar card and an active mobile number to the hospital. You will receive an OTP, be issued a physical token, pay the ₹50 fee, and receive your OPD slip.

### Important Information

*   **Assistance:** For specific queries regarding LARI Cardiology, you may contact the LARI Cardiology PRO office at **9415099528**.

Pre-booking is strongly recommended to avoid long wait times. If you have a medical emergency, please proceed directly to the Trauma Centre (Gate 14).

entries.question: यह गांठ मेरे पिता को भी था
entries.answer:
परिवार में इस तरह की समस्या का इतिहास होना एक महत्वपूर्ण जानकारी है, जिसे आपको डॉक्टर को अवश्य बताना चाहिए। कुछ प्रकार की गांठें या बीमारियां अनुवांशिक (hereditary) हो सकती हैं, इसलिए डॉक्टर के लिए आपकी पारिवारिक हिस्ट्री को समझना जरूरी है।

चूंकि यह समस्या आपके पिता को भी थी, इसलिए आपको इसे नजरअंदाज नहीं करना चाहिए। कृपया किसी विशेषज्ञ डॉक्टर से परामर्श लें ताकि वे इसकी सही जांच और निदान कर सकें।

KGMU mein operation ke liye seedhe appointment nahi li jaati hai. Iske liye aapko pehle OPD (Outpatient Department) mein dikhana hoga. Kripya niche di gayi prakriya ka paalan karein:

1. **OPD Registration:** Sabse pehle aapko sambhandhit department ki OPD mein registration karwana hoga. Aap online (ORS portal - https://ors.gov.in) ya phir hospital pahunch kar walk-in registration kar sakte hain. OPD ka samay somvar se shukravar, subah 9:00 baje se dopehar 1:00 baje tak aur shanivar ko subah 9:00 baje se dopehar 12:00 baje tak hota hai.
2. **Doctor se Paramarsh:** OPD mein doctor aapki jaanch karenge. Agar doctor ko lagega ki aapko operation ki avashyakta hai, toh ve aapko aage ki jaanch aur operation ke liye suggest karenge.
3. **Admission/Surgery Process:** Doctor dwara di gayi salah ke baad, aapko hospital ke admission counter par jaakar apni file process karni hogi.

**Kuch mahatvapurn baatein:**
*   **Referral:** Agar aap Lucknow ke bahar se aa rahe hain, toh apne saath us vishay (department) ka valid referral letter zaroor layein.
*   **OPD Fee:** OPD slip ki keemat ₹50 hai.
*   **Help:** Agar aapko kisi specific department ki jaanch karni hai, toh aap yahan dekh sakte hain: https://www.kgmu.org/department.php

**Sachet rahein:** Main ek AI hoon aur medical advice nahi de sakta. Kripya apne ilaaj ke liye KGMU ke doctor se hi sampark karein. Apni suraksha ke liye is chat mein apna Aadhaar number, phone number ya koi bhi personal medical record share na karein.

entries.question: Mujhe dentist ka appointment chahiye
entries.answer:
KGMU में दंत चिकित्सा (Dentistry) के लिए अपॉइंटमेंट लेने के लिए आप निम्नलिखित तरीकों का उपयोग कर सकते हैं:

1.  **ऑनलाइन बुकिंग (ORS):** आप [https://ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) पर जाकर अपना पंजीकरण कर सकते हैं और दंत चिकित्सा विभाग के लिए अपॉइंटमेंट बुक कर सकते हैं।
2.  **SMS द्वारा:** आप अपने मोबाइल से `APPOINTMENT <नाम>` लिखकर **8887019134** पर भेज सकते हैं।
3.  **वॉक-इन (Walk-in):** आप सीधे अस्पताल आकर भी पंजीकरण करा सकते हैं। इसके लिए अपना आधार कार्ड और सक्रिय मोबाइल नंबर साथ लाएं।
4.  **परामर्श शुल्क:** सभी बुकिंग विधियों के लिए OPD पर्ची का शुल्क ₹50 है।

**महत्वपूर्ण जानकारी:**
*   ऑनलाइन पंजीकरण अनिवार्य है।
*   OPD का समय सोमवार से शुक्रवार सुबह 9:00 बजे से दोपहर 1:00 बजे तक और शनिवार को सुबह 9:00 बजे से दोपहर 12:00 बजे तक है।
*   पर्ची काउंटर दोपहर 1:00 बजे बंद हो जाता है, इसलिए समय से पहले पहुंचना उचित है।
*   यदि आप शहर से बाहर से आ रहे हैं, तो संबंधित विभाग के लिए वैध रेफरल (Referral) पत्र साथ जरूर लाएं।

अधिक जानकारी के लिए आप KGMU की वेबसाइट [www.kgmu.org](http://www.kgmu.org) देख सकते हैं या 0522-2258880 / 0522-3539333 पर कॉल कर सकते हैं।

entries.question: how to apply for Appointment
entries.answer:
To book an appointment at KGMU, you must have a valid Aadhaar number and an active mobile number. Online registration is mandatory.

### Booking Methods

1.  **Online via ORS (Recommended):**
    *   Visit [https://ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in).
    *   Select **Uttar Pradesh** as the state and **KGMU** as the hospital.
    *   Choose your required department, date, and time.
    *   Enter patient details and pay the **₹50 fee**.
    *   Download and print your appointment slip.

2.  **ABHA / Health Care App:**
    *   Register using your mobile number and OTP.
    *   Follow the same steps as the ORS portal to select KGMU and book your slot.

3.  **SMS Booking:**
    *   Send an SMS in the format `APPOINTMENT <Patient Name>` to **8887019134**.

4.  **Walk-in Registration:**
    *   Visit the hospital with your Aadhaar card and active mobile number.
    *   You will receive an OTP for verification.
    *   Collect your physical token, pay the **₹50 fee**, and obtain your OPD slip.

### Important Information
*   **OPD Timings:** Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM; Saturday, 9:00 AM – 12:00 PM (Closed on Sundays).
*   **Parchi/Ticket Counter:** Closes at 1:00 PM sharp.
*   **Referral:** Patients from outside Lucknow must bring a valid referral for the specific department.
*   **Pre-booking:** It is strongly recommended to pre-book to avoid long wait times.

*Note: I am not qualified to provide medical advice. Please consult a doctor at KGMU OPD or call the helpline at 0522-2258880 or 0522-3539333. Please avoid sharing personal details in this chat for your safety.*

entries.answer:

Iske liye aap ye prakriya apnayein:

1. **Police se sampark karein:** Jis police station ne postmortem ke liye case refer kiya tha, aap vahan ke Investigating Officer (IO) se sampark karein.
2. **KGMU Forensic Medicine Department:** Postmortem report ka record 'Forensic Medicine & Toxicology' vibhag mein hota hai. Aap vahan jakar adhikarik prakriya ke baare mein jankari le sakte hain.
3. **Sahayak dastavez:** Report prapt karne ke liye aapko police dwara jari kiya gaya anurodh patra (requisition letter) aur apni pehchan (ID proof) ki avashyakta ho sakti hai.

Aap adhik jankari ke liye KGMU ke Forensic Medicine & Toxicology vibhag se sampark kar sakte hain:

entries.question: Aur yaha doctor har problem ke liye bahut sare test kyu karwate hai jiske liye logo ko alag alag jagah line lagani padti aur kuch doctor bhi thode rude hai
entries.answer:
KGMU ek bada tertiary care referral hospital hai, jahan desh bhar se gambhir aur jatil bimariyon wale mareez aate hain. Aapki pareshani samajhne layak hai, aur iske piche kuch mukhya kaaran ho sakte hain:

**1. Test kyun zaroori hote hain?**
KGMU mein doctors ka uddeshya bimari ka bilkul sahi nidaan (diagnosis) karna hota hai. Kai baar bimari ke lakshan ek jaise hote hain, isliye sahi ilaj shuru karne ke liye doctors ko blood test, imaging (X-ray/MRI), ya anya jaanchon ki zaroorat padti hai. Isse ilaj mein galti ki sambhavna kam ho jaati hai.

**2. Line aur bheed ki samasya:**
KGMU mein mareezon ki sankhya bahut zyada hai. Rozana hazaron ki tadad mein mareez aate hain, jiske kaaran labs aur counters par line lagna ek chunauti ban jaati hai. Hum koshish karte hain ki digital suvidhaon (jaise online registration) se ise kam kiya ja sake, lekin bheed adhik hone ke kaaran samay lag sakta hai.

**3. Doctor ka vyavahar:**
Doctor ka kaam kaafi dabav (pressure) wala hota hai, kyunki unhe rozana bahut bade mareezon ke group ko dekhna padta hai. Halanki, ek doctor se achhe vyavahar ki ummeed rakhna har mareez ka adhikar hai. Agar aapko kisi doctor ke vyavahar se pareshani hai, toh aap:
*   **PRO (Public Relations Officer) Office:** KGMU mein PRO office hota hai, aap wahan apni shikayat darj kara sakte hain.
*   **Patient Welfare Office:** Trauma Centre ya anya vibhagon mein patient welfare office hote hain, wahan bhi aap madad maang sakte hain.
*   **Feedback:** Aap university ke official channels ya website par apna sujhav de sakte hain taaki vyavastha mein sudhar ho sake.

**Ek sujhav:**
*   **Pre-booking:** Hamesha online (ORS portal) se appointment lekar aayen, isse OPD mein samay bach sakta hai.
*   **Referral:** Agar aap bahar se aa rahe hain, toh apne doctor ka referral saath rakhein taaki sahi department mein hi aapko bheja jaye aur faltu ke test se bacha ja sake.

Hum samajhte hain ki ye process thaka dene wala ho sakta hai, aur humari koshish hai ki is project ke madhyam se aapko sahi jaankari mil sake taaki aapka kaam thoda aasaan ho.

entries.question: Lekin in sab chakkar o me pura din beet jane per bhi test ke date nahi mil pati
entries.answer:
Main aapki pareshani aur frustration ko puri tarah samajh sakta hoon. KGMU jaise bade sansthan mein bheed aur lambi waiting list ke kaaran samay par test ki date na mil pana waqai bahut mushkil hota hai.

Agar aapko test ki date milne mein kathinai ho rahi hai, toh aap ye kadam utha sakte hain:

1. **PRO Office se Sampark Karein:** Agar aapko lagta hai ki aapka test bahut zaroori hai aur date bahut lambi mil rahi hai, toh aap **PRO (Public Relations Officer) Office** mein jakar apni samasya batayein. PRO office mareezon ki madad ke liye hi hota hai aur kabhi-kabhi wo process ko samajhne ya usmein madad karne mein margdarshan kar sakte hain.
2. **CMS (Chief Medical Superintendent) Office:** Agar mamla bahut gambhir hai aur aapko lagta hai ki test mein deri aapke ilaj par bura asar daal sakti hai, toh aap CMS office mein apni shikayat ya request letter de sakte hain.
3. **Emergency/Urgent Case:** Agar aapke doctor ne test ko 'Urgent' ya 'Emergency' category mein likha hai, toh us slip ko dikhakar aap lab ya radiology department ke in-charge se request kar sakte hain. 
4. **Online Portal ki Jaanch:** Kuch tests ki reports ya appointment ki sthiti aap KGMU ki official website ya result portal par check kar sakte hain, taaki aapko baar-baar line mein na lagna pade.

**Kuch zaroori baatein:**
* **Referral:** Agar aap kisi bahar ke doctor se referral lekar aaye hain, toh koshish karein ki wo referral letter aur purani reports lekar hi jayein, isse doctor ko baar-baar wahi test likhne ki zaroorat nahi padegi.
* **Sahayata Kendra:** KGMU mein bane 'Help Desk' par jaakar poochein ki kya koi test kisi dusri lab mein ya kisi aur samay par jaldi ho sakta hai.

Main ek AI hoon, isliye main direct appointment toh book nahi kar sakta, lekin aap **PRO Office (9415007710)** par call karke apni sthiti ke baare mein pooch sakte hain ki kya koi aur raasta hai. 

Humein khed hai ki aapko itni pareshani uthani pad rahi hai. Aapka feedback bahut zaroori hai taaki aane wale samay mein vyavastha mein sudhar ho sake.

entries.question: Mujhe sikayat nahi karni lekin is problem ka koi to possible solution hoga jisse e dikkat thodi kam ho jaye
entries.answer:
Aapki baat bilkul sahi hai—shikayat karne se zyada zaroori hai ki **samadhan (solution)** mil sake taaki aapka samay aur urja bache. KGMU jaise bade hospital mein bheed ko manage karna ek badi chunauti hai, lekin kuch vyavaharik (practical) tarike apna kar aap apni pareshani ko kaafi kam kar sakte hain:

**1. "Early Bird" Strategy (Subah jaldi aana):**
KGMU mein counter aur lab subah 9:00 baje se shuru hote hain, lekin bheed 7:00-8:00 baje se hi shuru ho jaati hai. Agar aap 7:30 baje tak pahunch jaate hain, toh aapka registration aur parchi katwane ka kaam jaldi ho sakta hai, jisse aapko din bhar ki lambi line se chhutkara mil sakta hai.

**2. Online Services ka poora upyog karein:**
*   **ORS (Online Registration System):** Hamesha [ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) ka upyog karein. Isse aapko hospital aane se pehle hi ek digital appointment mil jaati hai, jisse OPD mein line mein lagne ka samay kaafi kam ho jata hai.
*   **SMS Appointment:** Agar aap online nahi kar sakte, toh `APPOINTMENT <NAME>` ko 8887019134 par SMS karein. Ye ek saral tarika hai.

**3. "Follow-up" ke liye sahi samay:**
Agar aapka test ho chuka hai aur aapko report dikhani hai ya follow-up ke liye aana hai, toh koshish karein ki wo din chunein jab OPD mein bheed thodi kam hoti hai. Aksar Monday aur Tuesday ko bheed sabse zyada hoti hai, isliye agar sambhav ho toh middle of the week (Wednesday/Thursday) ka chayan karein.

**4. Documents ka "Master File" banayein:**
Aksar bheed mein samay tab zyada barbaad hota hai jab hum papers dhoondhte hain. Ek file banayein jismein:
*   Aadhaar card ki photocopy.
*   Pichli saari reports (original aur photocopy).
*   Doctor ki purani parchi.
*   Referral letter.
Jab aap doctor ke paas jayen, toh ye sab ready rakhein. Isse doctor ko aapka case samajhne mein jaldi hogi aur wo bina baat ke baar-baar test nahi likhenge.

**5. Generic vs Branded:**
Doctor se seedha puchein: *"Sir/Ma'am, kya is dawa ka koi generic ya sasta alternative hai jo hospital ki pharmacy mein mil sake?"* Aksar doctors generic dawaiyan likhne ke liye taiyar hote hain agar aap unse vinamrata se puchein.

**6. Help Desk ka upyog:**
Har bade vibhag ke bahar ek 'Help Desk' hota hai. Line mein lagne se pehle wahan jakar ye puchein: *"Mujhe ye test karwana hai, iska sabse kam bheed wala counter kaunsa hai?"* ya *"Kya ye test aaj ho payega ya kal aana hoga?"* Isse aapka 2-3 ghante ka intezar bach sakta hai.

**7. Digital Reports:**
Agar lab mein report online dekhne ki suvidha hai, toh baar-baar counter par jane ke bajaye online check karein. KGMU ki website par result section check karte rahein.

**Ek aakhri sujhav:**
Jab aap doctor se milein, toh ek chhota sa note (paper) lekar jayein jismein aapki saari pareshaniyan likhi hon. Isse aapka koi sawal nahi chhootega aur doctor ko bhi jaldi samajh aayega. 

KGMU mein bheed kam karna ek lambi prakriya hai, lekin ye chhote kadam aapke liye "hospital ke chakkar" kam kar sakte hain. Aapki dhairya (patience) ki hum sarahna karte hain.

entries.question: Achha kya sabhi test ke daam private hospital jitna hota hai
entries.answer:
Nahi, KGMU mein test ke daam **private hospitals ki tulna mein bahut kam (subsidized)** hote hain. KGMU ek sarkari sansthan (Government University) hai, isliye yahan ki fees ka dhancha (rate list) aam janta ki suvidha ko dhyan mein rakh kar tay kiya gaya hai.

Yahan kuch mukhya baatein hain jo aapko samajhni chahiye:

1.  **Sarkari Rate:** KGMU mein tests aur procedures ki ek official rate list hai. Yahan tests ki keemat private labs ke muqable aksar 50% se 80% tak kam hoti hai. 
    *   *Udaharan ke liye:* Ek chhota blood test ya X-ray jahan private mein ₹500-₹1000 ka ho sakta hai, wahan KGMU mein ye bahut kam daam par uplabdh hota hai.
2.  **Rate List Summary:** KGMU ki official rate list ke anusar, kuch tests ke daam ₹15 se lekar ₹5,000 ke beech hote hain (jaise ki MRI ya complex scans). Private hospitals mein yahi tests ₹10,000 se ₹20,000 tak ja sakte hain.
3.  **BPL/Ayushman Card:** Agar aapke paas **Ayushman Bharat Yojana** ka card hai ya aap BPL (Below Poverty Line) category mein aate hain, toh bahut se tests aur ilaaj ka kharcha sarkar uthati hai, jisse aapko bilkul muft ya bahut kam daam par suvidha mil sakti hai.
4.  **Kahan dekhein rates?** Aap KGMU ki official website par [Rate List](https://www.kgmu.org/rate_list2223.htm) dekh sakte hain. Isse aapko pehle hi pata chal jayega ki kis test ki kya fees hai, taaki koi aapko galat paise na mange.

**Ek zaroori savdhani:**
*   KGMU ke andar sirf official counters par hi paise jama karein aur hamesha **pakka bill (receipt)** lein. 
*   Agar koi bahar ka vyakti ya koi aur aapse zyada paise mange, toh usse saavdhaan rahein. 
*   Hospital ke official counters ke alawa kahin aur paise na dein.

KGMU mein ilaj aur tests ka kharcha private hospitals ke muqable bahut zyada kifayati (affordable) hai, isliye yahan bheed zyada hoti hai kyunki har koi yahan sasta aur achha ilaj chahta hai.

entries.question: Aur medicine ki price
entries.answer:
KGMU mein dawaiyon (medicines) ki keemat ke baare mein kuch mukhya baatein niche di gayi hain, jinhe jaan kar aap apna kharcha kaafi kam kar sakte hain:

1. **Amrit Pharmacy (Hospital ke andar):** KGMU campus ke andar 'Amrit Pharmacy' (Affordable Medicines and Reliable Implants for Treatment) ke kendra hote hain. Yahan dawaiyan aur implants bazar ki kimat se **kaafi kam daam (discounted rates)** par uplabdh hoti hain. Hamesha koshish karein ki dawaiyan inhi kendron se khareedein.

2. **Generic vs Branded:**
   - **Branded dawaiyan:** Inki kimat zyada hoti hai kyunki inka marketing aur brand value ka kharcha jud jata hai.
   - **Generic dawaiyan:** Ye wahi asar karti hain jo branded dawaiyan karti hain, lekin inki kimat bahut kam hoti hai.
   - **Sujhav:** Jab doctor aapko parchi (prescription) likh kar dein, toh aap unse vinamrata se pooch sakte hain ki, *"Kya iska koi generic ya sasta option hai jo hospital ki pharmacy mein mil jaye?"* Aksar doctors generic name likhne ya samjhne mein madad kar dete hain.

3. **Hospital ki apni Pharmacy:** KGMU ki apni pharmacy par sarakaari rates hote hain jo private medical stores se saste hote hain. Hamesha koshish karein ki hospital ke andar ki pharmacy se hi dawa lein, kyunki bahar ke medical stores par daam zyada ho sakte hain.

4. **Ayushman Bharat aur Anyay Yojna:** Agar aapka naam Ayushman Bharat scheme mein hai, toh bahut si zaroori dawaiyan aur injections aapko **muft (free)** mil sakte hain. Apne vibhag ke 'Patient Welfare' ya 'Ayushman Desk' par jakar zaroor pata karein ki aapki dawa is scheme ke antargat aati hai ya nahi.

5. **Emergency ka 24-ghante ka niyam:** KGMU ke Trauma Centre aur emergency mein pehle 24 ghante ka ilaaj aur zaroori dawaiyan/samaan aksar free ya bahut kam daam par uplabdh karaya jata hai.

**Kuch zaroori tips:**
*   **Parchi check karein:** Dawa kharidne se pehle parchi par likhi dawaiyon ke naam aur unki quantity (kitni leni hai) ko dhyan se padhein.
*   **Rate list:** Agar aapko kisi dawa ki kimat bahut zyada lag rahi hai, toh wahan baithe pharmacist se us dawa ka 'Generic' version maangein.
*   **Bahar ki dukano se bachein:** Hospital ke gate ke bilkul bahar wale stores aksar mehange ho sakte hain. Koshish karein ki hospital ke andar ke official Amrit Pharmacy ya KGMU pharmacy ka hi upyog karein.

**Ek aakhri baat:** Kabhi bhi kisi anjaan vyakti ki salah par hospital ke bahar kisi khas dukaan se dawa na khareedein. Hamesha official counters aur pharmacy ka hi istemal karein.

entries.question: Opd booking
entries.answer:
Online registration for KGMU OPD is mandatory. You can book an appointment using the following methods:

*   **ORS (Online Registration System):** Visit [https://ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in), select Uttar Pradesh, choose KGMU, and follow the steps to book your department, date, and time.
*   **ABHA/Health Care App:** Register using your mobile number and OTP, then follow the same state and hospital selection flow as ORS.
*   **SMS:** Send `APPOINTMENT <Patient Name>` to **8887019134**.
*   **Walk-in:** You can visit the hospital with your Aadhaar card and an active mobile number to receive an OTP, collect a physical token, and pay the ₹50 fee to get your OPD slip.

**Important Information:**
*   **Fee:** The OPD slip fee is ₹50 for all booking methods.
*   **Timings:** OPD operates Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–1:00 PM; Saturday, 9:00 AM–12:00 PM (closed Sundays).
*   **Parchi/Ticket Counter:** Closes at 1:00 PM sharp.
*   **Referral:** Patients from outside Lucknow must bring a valid referral for the specific department.
*   **Recommendation:** Pre-booking is strongly advised to avoid long wait times.

I'm not qualified to provide medical advice. Please consult a doctor at KGMU OPD or call the helpline at **0522-2258880** or **0522-3539333**. Also, please avoid sharing personal details in this chat for your safety.
